headline: ICICI shares details of 1838 Reserve
summary: Premium travel and lifestyle privileges, including zero forex markup. Access is by invitation through a Relationship Manager or registration of interest.
availabilityNote: Currently listed by ICICI Bank; invitation required. See Browse Cards for the fee and access details.

headline: ICICI business-card DCC fee and selected card benefits change
summary: From 25 Nov, the DCC fee on selected business, corporate and purchase cards rises from 1% to 3.50%. From 15 Dec, complimentary air-accident insurance ends on Emeralde Private Metal, Times Black, Emeralde, Emeralde Private, Diamant, Sapphiro and Rubyx; the INOX benefit ends on Rubyx, Coral, Expressions, Chennai Super Kings, selected MakeMyTrip cards, HPCL Super Saver and Emirates Rubyx.
availabilityNote: Card-specific changes apply; see ICICI’s notice for the affected product list and other fee updates.

cardName: SBI Card transport and fuel transaction fees
headline: SBI Card adds fees above transport and fuel thresholds
summary: From 1 Dec 2026, a 1% fee applies to transportation transactions above ₹30,000 each (MCC 4111, 4784 and 4131). If aggregate fuel transactions exceed ₹50,000 in a billing cycle, a 1% fee applies to total fuel spend (MCC 5172, 5541, 5542 and 5983).
availabilityNote: SBI Card identifies the covered transactions by merchant category code (MCC); consult the issuer notice for scope and terms.

cardName: Tata Neu HDFC Bank Credit Cards
headline: Tata Neu HDFC cardholders must claim spend-earned NeuCoins
summary: Effective 25 Nov 2026, primary cardholders must claim spend-earned NeuCoins in the Tata Neu app: sign in with the bank-registered mobile number, open NeuCard and choose “Claim NeuCoins.” Claims must be made within 12 months of the statement date; unclaimed coins expire.
availabilityNote: New claim flow applies to eligible card-spend NeuCoins. Promotions and welcome benefits keep their own terms; see the bank’s claim and redemption guide.
